name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in 3D renders without bloating compute time, which directly boosts visual fidelity—a 0.5%+ gain in perceived quality. The trade-off is a slight increase in memory usage during upscaling, but the model’s lightweight design keeps it manageable.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasted effort; VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution will still ghost on high-motion scenes. Settle it by running a blind A/B test: compare depth-aware upscaling vs. VFI-Flow on a 10-second high-motion clip—if the latter scores higher in user preference, drop the upscaler entirely.
